goalZh: 会用常用不规则动词的过去式讲一次出游
canDoZh: 能讲讲一次出游:去了哪儿、怎么去的、看到了什么、吃了什么

newItems.noteZh: a weekend trip 周末出游;去旅行 take a trip;How was your trip? 玩得怎么样?
美式卷舌 /kɑːr/;坐车去 by car、in his car。
过去式 drove;美国很多地方不开车很难出门。
h 不发音,所以说 an hour(用 an);两个小时 two hours。
过去式 made;make sandwiches 做三明治;但"做作业"说 do homework。
d 通常不发音:"SAN-wich";复数 sandwiches。
v 开头,上齿轻咬下唇;The view was awesome! 风景太美了!
过去式 came back;We came back at nine.。

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: Hey, Lei! How was your trip to the mountains?
lines.zh: 嘿,磊!去山里玩得怎么样?

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: Awesome! We got up at six, and Marcus drove.
lines.zh: 太棒了!我们六点就起床了,马库斯开的车。

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: Wow! How long were you in the car?
lines.zh: 哇!你们在车上坐了多久?

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: Two hours. Then we went hiking for four hours!
lines.zh: 两个小时。然后我们走了四个小时的山路!

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: Yes! We had lunch there. I made sandwiches.
lines.zh: 看到了!我们在那儿吃的午饭,三明治是我做的。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: Beautiful! I took a lot of pictures. Then it rained.
lines.zh: 美极了!我拍了好多照片。后来下雨了。

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: Oh no! When did you come back?
lines.zh: 哎呀!你们什么时候回来的?

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: We bought coffee and came back at nine.
lines.zh: 我们买了咖啡,九点才回来。

questions.prompt: 他们怎么去的山里?路上花了多久?
questions.explainZh: We got up at six, and Marcus drove. —— How long were you in the car? —— Two hours.(走了四个小时的是山路)

questions.prompt: 他们几点回来的?回来前做了什么?
questions.explainZh: We bought coffee and came back at nine.

grammar.titleZh: 常用不规则动词的过去式
grammar.bodyZh: 很多常用动词的过去式不加 -ed,要单独记:go → went,have → had,see → saw,take → took,get → got,make → made,buy → bought,drive → drove,come → came,eat → ate。它们同样不随人称变:I went / Marcus went。问句和否定照样用 did / didn't,后面回到原形:Did you go hiking?(不说 Did you went?),We didn't see the lake.。固定说法也跟着变:get up → got up,take pictures → took pictures,come back → came back。发音:bought 的 gh 不发音,读 /bɑːt/;took 的 oo 读短音 /ʊ/。

examples.text: I made sandwiches, and we had lunch at the lake.
examples.zh: 我做了三明治,我们在湖边吃了午饭。

examples.text: Did you see the lake? — Yes, we did.
examples.zh: 你们看到湖了吗?——看到了。
